definitions.explanation: The state of being unable to make a decision, going back and forth without taking action. Often implies reluctance to move forward due to uncertainty or doubt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After a moment's hesitation, he made his decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This is no time to hesitate.

notes:
WRITING:
- {逡|しゅん} - to hesitate, to retreat
- {巡|じゅん} - to go around, to patrol

The compound captures the idea of going back and forth, retreating and circling without progressing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to hesitate, to waver
- {逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ - after much hesitation
- {逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ - to show signs of hesitation
- {逡巡|しゅんじゅん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ - without hesitation

USAGE:
Somewhat literary and formal. Used in:
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ - novels
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ - articles
- Formal speech
{逡巡|しゅんじゅん} has a slightly more literary tone than ⟦{躊躇|ちゅうちょ}→躊躇：07722_chuucho⟧ and suggests prolonged hesitation with internal conflict.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{躊躇|ちゅうちょ}→躊躇：07722_chuucho⟧ - hesitation (more common)
- ⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷い：19437_mayoi⟧ - doubt, wavering
- ためらい - hesitation
- ⟦{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}→優柔不断：16842_yuujuufudan⟧ - indecisiveness

REGISTER:
Slightly formal/literary. Common in written Japanese and formal discussions.
